title: Specialty Pharmacy Program Reckoning Note — Amount of a Maximizer Program Draw
content:
## Clauses

**1. The draw.** Under the Specialty Pharmacy Program, the maximizer program draw on the latest shipped fill is the lesser of the fill's unpaid remainder and the whole benefit available. The benefit is not spread. The draw is never below zero, and it is rounded to the nearest cent at the end. The draw is never above the fill's unpaid remainder.

**2. The fill.** The latest shipped fill is the enrollment's shipped fill with the latest ship date. Its unpaid remainder is its cost share less the payments already posted on it, from any payer.

**3. Benefit available.** The benefit available is the assistance balance shown on the enrollment, with nothing taken off for program use at retail pharmacies. The benefit available is never below zero.

**4. Draws counted against a load.** The program draws taken off a benefit load are those of the last 12 months, meaning draws dated fewer than 12 whole months before today.

**5. Draw horizon.** The draw horizon runs from today to the last day of the program year of the latest load, which is December 31 of the year named on the latest benefit load.

**6. Fill period.** A fill period is 30 days.

**7. Even draw.** The even draw is the benefit available divided by the number of fills left. The fills left are the fill being paid plus the whole fill periods that fit in the draw horizon, counted in days from today. The even draw is figured from the benefit available before any rounding.

**8. Rounding.** The payment is rounded to the nearest cent only once, on the final figure.

## Worked figures (assumed inputs)

| Input | Figure |
|---|---|
| Cost share of the latest shipped fill | $1,200.00 |
| Payments already posted on that fill | $0.00 |
| Assistance balance shown on the enrollment | $9,000.00 |

- Unpaid remainder: **$1,200.00**.
- Benefit available: **$9,000.00**.
- Draw: the lesser of $1,200.00 and $9,000.00, which is **$1,200.00**.

With a shown assistance balance of $700.00 instead, the draw is **$700.00**.

**Even draw on the same assumptions.** Today is 2026-10-08 and the latest load is for program year 2026, so the horizon to 2026-12-31 is 84 days. Two whole 30-day periods fit in 84 days, so the fills left are 3. The even draw is $9,000.00 divided by 3, which is $3,000.00.
